_comment: Tier-2 for dune::eigenvalue#0, dune::eigenvalue#2 and the two Signal keys of _general.assemble_measured — one assembled matrix answers all four, wall time 2 s on a warm cache (2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured: dune.fem has no eig / eigs / eigsh / eigenvalue / eigenvalues / eigenSolver attribute and `import dune.fem.solver` raises ModuleNotFoundError; assemble(form) returns a LinearOperator whose only conversion attribute is ['as_numpy']; .as_numpy is a scipy csr_matrix with format 'csr' and .tocsr() is the same object, so fancy-indexing it directly gave a (144,144) csr_matrix identical to the .tocsr() route (max|diff| 0.0) — the retracted COO claim stays retracted. assemble(a, DirichletBC(space,[0])) was ACCEPTED and changed nothing: nnz 2401 both ways, max|A1-A2| exactly 0.0. The control that makes that meaningful is in the same run: the galerkin scheme's own matrix DOES differ from the raw one (max|diff| 0.333333), so 'ignored' is distinguishable from 'this bc happens to be a no-op'.
